card.name: Hyphens inside toll-free phone numbers
card.fires_on: The hyphen, dash or digit inside a US toll-free phone number, mainly right after 1-800 or 800. It is strongest in the NCI Cancer Information Service number 1-800-4-CANCER (1-800-422-6237).

modes.label: Phone number separators
modes.description: The dash or digit partway through a toll-free number, after the 800 or 844 area code.

modes.label: Stray other matches
modes.description: Occasional unrelated hits, such as a verb in census-style household text.

card.plain: It lights up on the dashes inside a toll-free phone number, as in the 1-800 cancer information line.
